newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul gold firms sligthly, trade thin.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul gold firms sligthly, trade thin.

text.p: Istanbul gold exchange volume firmed slightly to 880 kilos on Monday from Friday's 752 kilos, but trade remained thin as the main world gold markets were closed due to public holidays, dealers said.
Gold rose to $345.00 an ounce from $343.60 on Friday, but closed only slightly firmer in lira terms at 1,539,000 lira per gram, versus 1,538,000 lira.
"With the main foreign markets closed for the day, there was not much activity on the exchange today. What trade there was, was physical demand from the free market," one dealer said.
The Turkish currency slipped to 139,300 to the dollar on Monday versus the previous 138,600.
All but 40 kilos of the day's trade was in lira terms, while most of the trade -- 565 kilos -- took place in the morning session.
